name: Balsamic Tofu Veggie Kebabs with Quinoa & Minted Yogurt Sauce

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups quinoa
1062 ml (4 ½ cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and dry mint. Pick the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. In a large bowl, prepare marinade by whisking together ½ of the garlic and mint (save the rest for the sauce), oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and medium dice tofu; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with marinade and toss to coat. Set aside.
Wash and dry bell peppers and mushrooms. Seed and large dice the bell peppers. Halve the mushrooms. Peel and large dice onion. Add vegetables to bowl with tofu and toss.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell pepper
0.341 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread tofu and vegetables onto skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu and vegetable pieces directly on the grill/skillet without skewers.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add tofu and vegetables; cook, turning occasionally, until tofu is browned and vegetables are tender, 8-10 minutes total.
In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together yogurt, salt, pepper, and remaining garlic and mint.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide quinoa and kebabs between dishes. Enjoy with yogurt sauce on the side!
